title: Qatar GKG share jump leads NTR returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT Qatar GKG share day-over-day pct change > 30 pct leads NTR log returns by 3 days (+) via Gulf urea export disruption; trade long NTR 5d [gdelt.gkg.qatar_share -> finance.NTR.log_return]
message: Not supported: Qatar GKG share does not lead NTR (best lag -5d, NTR leads news; perm p=0.18, Bonferroni 1.0). Rule: 37 trades, hit 54%, excess +0.01%/trade; war OOS 7 trades hit 29% avg -0.58%; actionability 4.05 - story not a rule.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.qatar_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long NTR next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT Qatar GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads MOS log returns by 5 days (-) as a reversal control: Qatar attention spikes precede fertilizer-equity mean reversion, not urea-disruption gains; trade short MOS 5d [gdelt.gkg.qatar_share -> finance.MOS.log_return] (parent: R2-0040)
